mo_ta_cong_viec:
Design, build, and maintain scalable backend systems using Java 21+ / Spring Boot 3+.
Implement microservices and APIs with a focus on performance, security, and resilience.
Optimize queries and data pipelines (MySQL/MongoDB).
Integrate with messaging systems (Kafka, Redis Pub/Sub) and API gateways (Kong/Traefik).
Lead code reviews, refactoring, and architecture discussions.
Collaborate with DevOps to deliver production-grade services on Docker/Docker Swarm/Kubernetes.
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to best practices.
yeu_cau:
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Management Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
8+ years of experience with Java backend development.
Strong knowledge of Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, asynchronous processing, and security standards (JWT/OAuth2).
Experience with RDBMS, query tuning, and caching strategies.
Hands-on with CI/CD (Jenkins, Git), containerization, and monitoring stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki).
Familiar with cloud or hybrid deployments.
Excellent problem-solving and system design skills.
Nice to have:
Knowledge of financial/trading systems or fintech platforms.
Familiarity with event-driven architecture and reactive programming.
Experience with high availability & zero downtime deployments.
quyen_loi:
Professional working environment, foreign language
Knowlegde in Securities/Finance/Bank progamming
Oppornities to learn about Securities Market

Salary: Negotiated during the interview.
Full-salary insurance in accordance with Vietnamese labor law.
13th-month salary and attractive year-end bonus based on individual performance and company business results.
12 annual leave days per year and additional days off following the State Securities Commission calendar.
Annual health check-up, company trips, and team-bonding internal activities.
Direct training and mentorship from experienced professionals in the industry.
100% sponsorship for professional license exams (brokerage, analysis, fund management), budget for foreign language courses, and other professional development programs.
